## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations mixed: SPY (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.89%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND show risk tilt while TLT (1W: -1.49% | 1M: -2.40%) BELOW TREND and weak sector breadth keep the regime neutral.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Tech leadership and large-cap strength: QQQ (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +13.70%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +4.23% | 1M: +31.66%) ABOVE TREND. Credit and yields provide counterbalance: HYG (1W: -0.31% | 1M: -0.21%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: -0.85%) BELOW TREND while VXX (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -2.91%) RECOVERY shows short-term volatility pick-up.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tighter: TLT (1W: -1.49% | 1M: -2.40%) BELOW TREND implies rising yields; HYG/LQD both BELOW TREND (HYG 1W: -0.31% | 1M: -0.21%; LQD 1W: -0.52% | 1M: -0.85%) point to flat-to-weakened credit conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +4.23% | 1M: +31.66%) ABOVE TREND; Energy also strong: XLE (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +3.00%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +17.55%) ABOVE TREND. Financials lag: XLF (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND — Style: Growth/Momentum showing strength.

**5. US vs Global?**
US large caps outperform: SPY (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.89%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +13.70%) ABOVE TREND, while EM/Emerging is mixed with EEM (1W: -0.41% | 1M: +7.99%) CORRECTION and FXI (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +3.71%) ABOVE TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed: momentum/spec tech strong (QQQ, SOXX ABOVE TREND) but small-cap and speculative ETFs in pullback — IWM (1W: -1.44% | 1M: +5.19%) CORRECTION, ARKK (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION, IBIT (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +7.10%) CORRECTION.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity strength broadening: CPER (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +8.08%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND, while gold GLD (1W: -0.11% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND shows limited safe-haven demand.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy sector and crude strong: XLE (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +3.00%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +17.55%) ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +5.07% | 1M: +3.98%) ABOVE TREND — consistent cyclical/commodity bid.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Large-cap tech (XLK, QQQ, SOXX) ABOVE TREND on both timeframes; Divergence: multiple correction signals in small-cap/innovation/EM (IWM, ARKK, IBIT) represent a MINOR divergence rather than a broad regime break given core large-cap confirmation.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth exposure: XLK (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +13.70%) ABOVE TREND and monitor commodity/energy exposure (CPER, XLE ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to lagging Financials XLF (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND and Utilities XLU (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -3.87%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +19.54%) ABOVE TREND; Energy XLE (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +3.00%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Financials XLF (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND; Utilities XLU (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -3.87%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial CPER (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +8.08%) ABOVE TREND and Brent BNO (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +17.55%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -0.11% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND and palladium PALL (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; large-cap tech and commodities showing relative strength (XLK and CPER ABOVE TREND). Key risk is the narrow advance—small-cap/innovation/EM corrections (IWM, ARKK, IBIT CORRECTION) that could cap upside if breadth fails to improve.
